name: rousing-rattle-drum-banish-wake-defender
notes: Rousing Rattle Drum (nxm05jkjxg, GeneratedMacroCode.php activateAbilityAbilities["nxm05jkjxg:0"] finds Animal/Beast allies for which IsUnitDefending() is true; customDQHandlers["nxm05jkjxg:0:ActivateAbility-1"] calls WakeupCard()): "Banish Rousing Rattle Drum: Wake up target defending Animal or Beast ally." A Cheerful Slime (ANIMAL) is seeded rested onto the field, and IsUnitDefending() is satisfied by directly setting the DecisionQueueController CombatTarget/CombatAttackerPlayer variables it reads (GameLogic.php ~21315), simulating this Slime being the current combat's defender, without scripting a full attack-and-block sequence. The Slime is seeded BEFORE Rousing Rattle Drum on the field so its own mzID index (myField-1) stays stable across the Drum's own banish-as-cost (removing a later index does not renumber an earlier one). Verified live: the Rattle Drum moves to the banishment zone as its own cost, and the Slime's Status goes from 1 (rested) to 2 (awake). Break/restore verified: commenting out WakeupCard() makes the fixture fail (Slime stays rested) and restoring it passes again.

rulesClauses: Banish Rousing Rattle Drum: Wake up target defending Animal or Beast ally.
